profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Designing AI Solutions, Leading Development Teams
profile.summary:
At Siemens Healthineers, my role as a Senior Software Engineer is defined by a dedication to advancing medical technology through artificial intelligence. With a specialized focus on AI-assisted Bi-RADS development, I lead a team that has successfully launched calculation and reporting systems on multiple ultrasound products. Our efforts have not only led to market success but also reduced costs and enhanced maintenance efficiency by replacing third-party solutions with an in-house DICOM Structured Report.

The recognition I've received, including the Excellence Award, underscores my commitment to innovation and patient-centered solutions. My expertise in C#, C++, Java, Win32 API, and .NET Framework, coupled with a proficiency in WCF and WPF, has been instrumental in developing robust software that supports healthcare professionals. Moreover, my hands-on experience in design and implementation aligns with Siemens Healthineers' mission to transform care delivery and improve patient outcomes.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Leading AI assisted Bi-RADS feature development
• Led a team of 9 software engineers developing calculation & reporting system, DICOM Structured Report and Patient Information Management System
• Designed and implemented calculation & reporting system on three different ultrasound products which successfully launched on the market
• Reduced license cost and maintenance time by designing and implementing in-house DICOM Structured Report solution to replace third party solution
• Designed and implemented customized Structured Report feature to support user created calculation labels to be transferred through DICOM standard (Won the Excellence Award)
• Developed calculation and DICOM Structured Report verification tool which reduced verification time by 70%
• Designed and implemented compact reporting system which reduced number of report pages by 60%
• Improved quality by introducing automated Coded UI test & unit test
• SAFe and KANBAN process trainer
Skills: C++, C#, DICOM Standard, Win32 API, .NET Framework, WPF, WCF, 
Visual Studio, TFS, Azure DevOps
positions.insights: Git, Artificial Intelligence (AI) for Medical Device and +2 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
• Designed and Implemented stress echo wall motion scoring and reporting system on three different products which successfully launched on the market 
• Designed and Implemented reporting system, system configuration and annotation component on company's first hand-carried ultrasound system
• Developed WPF-based ultrasound reporting system
• Addressed  XSLT debugging issue by introducing LINQ to XML
Skills: C++, C#, Win32 API, .NET Framework, WCF, WPF, COM, XML, XSLT, 
HTML, Visual Studio, TFS, ClearCase

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Developed fast boot-up feature that turns on hand-carried ultrasound system 5 times faster using HORM technology (Won the Innovation Award)
• Reduced operating system license cost by 75% by introducing Windows Embedded OS (Won the Cost Productivity Award)
• Automated Operating System creation process by introducing WES(Windows Embedded Standard) ICE (Image Configuration Editor)
• Designed and implemented a new system configuration component by introducing WPF for the first time in the company
Skills: C++, C#, Win32 API, .NET Framework, WCF, WPF, COM, XML, Visual Studio, Clear Case

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• As a full stack software engineer, developed financial framework database I/O tool  which converts database SQL into C code module
• Designed and implemented runtime environment that execute C code module, logging and error handling
Skills: JAVA, C/C++, proC, XML, WAS, JDBC, EMF, SWT, JFACE, JET, Eclipse Ganymede, Unix, Oracle

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• As a technical lead of a team of 5 software developers, carried out a national project that develops robot software framework and robot software development platform
Skills: Java, C/C++, JSP, XML, UPnP middleware, CORBA middlewar, JavaScript, Applet, Swing
